Chaos damage, 5 Golem gems, 87 red uniques rewritten, defence no longer doubles as damage, better events and a fixed Catacombs. It is an alpha playtest: meta and damage will keep changing.

Hits lay Entropy on enemies. It implodes 3 seconds later as Chaos damage that ignores Armour and elemental Resistance, and an enemy that dies owing Entropy bursts onto the pack.
A Chaos support, 5 chaos supports, one chaos keystone per class (any class can take any), 7 chaos reds and 6 chaos Oathwords.
